rebuttal_or_critique: I have carefully considered the arguments for a shift to a neutral stance. While the moderation in core inflation is a positive development, the headline CPI at 4.85% remains uncomfortably above the 4.00% target. As an expert focused on the rural economy, I am particularly concerned that food inflation at 8.52% continues to erode purchasing power and poses a risk to the durability of the growth recovery. Given the positive output gap of 0.40% and the volatility in global crude oil prices, I believe that signaling a shift in stance now would be premature and could risk unanchoring inflation expectations. I will maintain my position to ensure that the disinflationary process is firmly established.
